description: Constraints are deliberately absent: Renovate reads them from package.json engines (node >=22), which is the floor the code has to run on. A literal here was a second source of truth that nothing verified — it said node 24 while engines said 22, so Renovate was free to pick a dependency the declared floor cannot run.

The Node version CI and the deploys run lives in .nvmrc, read by every workflow through .github/actions/node-setup. Renovate's nvm manager updates that file; a `node-version:` literal in a workflow is invisible to every manager it has.

packageRules.description: Types track the engines floor (Node >=22), not CI's Node 24 runtime — keeps Node-23+/24-only APIs out of code that must still run on 22.
TS 7 (native compiler) is out of peer range for typescript-eslint (>=4.8.4 <6.1.0, crashes at runtime) and @sveltejs/kit (^5.3.3 || ^6.0.0). Drop this rule once both support it.
